implementation: Bounded OSC 8 destinations survive Ghostty, negotiated v6 snapshots and disk/live history.
Command-click dispatches visible HTTP(S), www addresses, labeled HTTP(S) and local file URIs; hover exposes the destination.
Default terminal text is 14 pixels; Appearance accepts direct 10-32 pixel entry and preserves saved sizes.
Old-service attachment fallback is bounded to one retry with the same identity and fingerprint.
History waits for a pending resize and cancels deferred requests on return to live; overlap reconciliation spans archive pages.
Focused-folder lookup is exposed to QML.

regression_controls: Cross-page resize overlap failed before its fix and passed afterward.
Malformed/truncated/oversized link metadata is rejected or omitted without dropping normal terminal text.
Invalid explicit destinations cannot fall back to opening the visible label.
Legacy and link-aware clients attach concurrently to the same real PTY child.
Invalid font entry restores the saved size; successful entry updates the live grid and persisted settings.
limitations: Native macOS pointer delivery, external application launching, native IME and GPU qualification were not rerun; these are background Qt results.
Existing services need the new service binary to supply OSC 8 metadata; the desktop falls back to visible links with an older service.
New services read old disk archives; older service binaries cannot decode newly archived pages containing the link extension.
The running user app and services were not replaced or restarted.
